summary: TOP Ships Inc., a Greek-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to its related-party share purchase agreement with Rubico Inc. for the sale of Roman Shark V Inc., holder of a shipbuilding contract with Guangzhou Shipyard International and China Shipbuilding Trading for one 47,499 dwt MR chemical/product tanker. Aggregate purchase price is $6.5 million, with $2.8 million settled in cash. The $3.7 million balance, originally due September 30, 2026, was extended to October 31, 2026 and may be settled in cash or Rubico Series G Convertible Preferred Shares. Watch for dilution risk and related-party collection.
